title: MiCLA: Mixture-to-Constituent Latent Alignment for Polyphonic Audio Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world audio typically contains concurrent sound events, yet standard self-supervised methods treat each clip as an isolated training unit without explicitly modeling mixture--constituent relationships. We propose Mixture-to-Constituent Latent Alignment (MiCLA), a two-stage self-supervised pre-training framework that uses synthetic log-mel mixing to align mixture representations with their constituent clips. Stage 1 structures single-clip representations via masked self-distillation and contrastive regularization. Stage 2 introduces bidirectional alignment: for a synthetic mixture, MiCLA suppresses the component aligned with one constituent and aligns the residual with the other, using projective residualization on patch tokens and sample-adaptive soft residualization on the global class token. translated_title: MiCLA：面向多声源音频表示学习的混合-成分潜在对齐
translated_abstract: 现实世界的音频通常包含同时发生的声音事件，然而标准的自监督方法将每个音频片段视为孤立的训练单元，没有显式建模混合音频与组成成分之间的关系。我们提出了混合-成分潜在对齐，这是一个两阶段自监督预训练框架，利用合成的对数梅尔频谱混合将混合音频的表示与其组成片段进行对齐。第一阶段通过掩码自蒸馏和对比正则化来构建单片段表示的结构。第二阶段引入双向对齐机制：对于合成混合音频，MiCLA 抑制与其中一个成分对齐的分量，并将残差与另一个成分对齐，具体做法是在 patch token 上采用投影残差化，在全局 class token 上采用样本自适应软残差化。在下游评估中，MiCLA 在微调设置下于 AS-20K 数据集上达到 43.2% 的平均精度均值，在 AS-2M 数据集上达到 50.3% 的 mAP，并且（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MiCLA 提出了一种两阶段自监督预训练框架，通过合成对数梅尔混合和双向潜在对齐来显式建模混合音频与其组成成分的关系，在 AudioSet 下游任务上取得了领先的 mAP 性能。
en_tdlr: MiCLA is a two-stage self-supervised pre-training framework that explicitly models mixture-constituent relationships via synthetic log-mel mixing and bidirectional latent alignment, achieving state-of-the-art mAP on AudioSet downstream tasks.
